comment: Level generator v2 (board 066, stage 2): the block-template catalog a region re-roll and a map expansion draw from, the expansion street plan, the start + goals rules. Read by Tools/TrainingGround/src/levelgen/v2Config.ts. Metres unless named _cm. Stage 3 (reference map -> style profile) will add a 'style' block that re-weights templates.catalog.*.weight.

templates.comment: force_change: a re-rolled block always gets another type than it had. candidates_per_lot: how many types a lot tries (seeded weighted order) before keeping its old content. inset_m: the margin a template keeps inside its lot.

classic.comment: The type each block of the classic Depot grammar (generate.ts section 3) has, by its region key. A classic-only type is not in the catalog: a re-roll replaces it by a catalog type.

expansion.comment: Canvas = the map's size x sqrt(factor) (x2 ~ 250 x 175, x4 ~ 354 x 248, x6 ~ 434 x 304 for the 177 x 124 Depot), the old map stays centred (its UE coordinates do not change). New area: a ring street round the old map, the old edge roads and the canal extended to the new edge, local streets every grid_step_m, the blocks between filled from templates.catalog.

objectives.comment: Start + 2-4 goals visited in any order. default_count by expansion factor (1 = not expanded). Distances in metres on the plan; reachability is the ground nav (evaluate.ts NavGrid).
